query:
SELECT id, nome, empresaSlug, cashbarberProfissionalId
FROM colaboradores
WHERE ativo = 1 AND empresaSlug = 'MORUMBI' AND id NOT IN (1,7,12,2,23,3,18,14,21,20)
ORDER BY nome;
